title.en: Vercel adds Kimi K3.1 Pro to AI Gateway
title.zhHans: Vercel 将 Kimi K3.1 Pro 接入 AI Gateway

searchSummary.en: Vercel listed Kimi K3.1 Pro and Highspeed in AI Gateway on October 23; full weights were still planned for November 4.
searchSummary.zhHans: Vercel 于 10 月 23 日将 Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 Highspeed 列入 AI Gateway；完整权重仍计划于 11 月 4 日发布。

summary.en: Vercel's October 23 changelog listed Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed as available through AI Gateway; Simon Willison separately reported using the Moonshot API that day. Moonshot's official page says full weights are planned by November 4 and carries visible October 24 metadata. This node records Vercel's gateway availability, not a definitively dated Moonshot-wide launch or an October open-weight release.
summary.zhHans: Vercel 于 10 月 23 日的更新日志中列出可通过 AI Gateway 使用的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro Highspeed；Simon Willison 也在同日记录了 Moonshot API 的使用情况。Moonshot 官方页面称完整权重计划于 11 月 4 日前发布，页面可见元数据日期为 10 月 24 日。本节点记录 Vercel 网关的可用性，不将其说成日期已完全确定的 Moonshot 全平台发布，也不称 10 月已开放权重。

narrative.en: The date is tied to Vercel's own changelog, not to a resolved date for Moonshot's original announcement. The Moonshot page metadata points to October 24, while Vercel and Simon Willison date their independent access records to October 23. The product/API stage is distinct from the planned November 4 weight release. No benchmark claim or actual usage scale is inferred.
narrative.zhHans: 日期依据 Vercel 自己的更新日志，Moonshot 原始公告日期仍未完全厘清。Moonshot 页面元数据指向 10 月 24 日，而 Vercel 与 Simon Willison 的访问记录日期为 10 月 23 日。产品/API 可用阶段与计划于 11 月 4 日开放权重是不同事项。本稿不推断跑分结论或实际使用规模。

text.en: Vercel's October 23, 2026 changelog made Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed available in AI Gateway; an independent practitioner also reported Moonshot API access that day.
text.zhHans: Vercel 于 2026 年 10 月 23 日的更新日志宣布 Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro Highspeed 可在 AI Gateway 使用；一位独立开发者也在当日记录了 Moonshot API 的访问。

text.en: Moonshot's official page says full weights are planned by November 4, 2026; the October gateway listing is not an open-weight release, and the official page's visible metadata points to October 24 rather than resolving the October 23/24 announcement-date difference.
text.zhHans: Moonshot 官方页面称完整权重计划于 2026 年 11 月 4 日前发布；10 月的网关上架不是开放权重发布，且官方页面可见元数据指向 10 月 24 日，尚不能消除 10 月 23/24 日的公告日期差异。
